Namaste, and welcome to BrightCampus! In the next few minutes, you'll watch a brand-new school come alive, from sign-up to its very first school day, with every single role connected. Let's go!
We begin with the BrightCampus platform team. Our super admin signs in to the platform workspace.
And here's the platform dashboard! Every school on BrightCampus lives here as an organization, with its own plan, usage and billing.
Exciting news! Sunrise Public School has just signed up. We enter the school's details, its office contact, and Kavitha, who will run the school as admin.
We choose the Standard plan, billed yearly, and click create. In one go, BrightCampus sets up the school, its space, and the admin's login. Super quick!
Notice this: the temporary password is shown only once, and it's never stored in plain text. Safe and secure, right from day one.
Now, let's become Kavitha, the school admin. She signs in with her temporary password.
Since someone else set that password, BrightCampus asks her to choose her own. Simple, and much safer!
A fresh, empty dashboard: no students, no teachers yet. But look, a setup guide shows exactly what's left. Let's continue!
The setup wizard takes her step by step. And guess what? School details are already done, because the address, phone and email came straight from onboarding. No typing twice!
Next, the academic year: 2026 to 27, from June to March, split into two semesters.
Classes and sections! For our demo, Sunrise runs Grade 3, section A, for up to 35 students.
Subjects are ticked for her: English, Hindi, Maths, Science, Social Studies and Computer Science. One click, and they're added to Grade 3!
Now, the school day. Six periods of forty-five minutes, starting at eight forty-five, with a fifteen-minute break after the third period.
Grading? Just one click for the CBSE scale. Done!
Time to bring in the team! Every staff member gets their own login. We add two teachers, Meera and Rohan, then Farah from accounts, and our principal.
Their temporary passwords appear once, ready to hand over. And yes, everyone changes theirs at first sign-in.
Fees next! Monthly tuition of three thousand two hundred rupees, and a one-time admission fee of eight thousand rupees, due on the tenth.
And now, the most important part, our students! Each child joins Grade 3 A, and a parent's email instantly creates the parent's app login. Welcome, Aarav, Diya and Kabir!
Three students, three happy parent logins, and the admission fee is already raised for each child. Nine out of nine steps, all done. Wonderful!
Every class needs a caring class teacher. Meera takes Grade 3 A. She'll mark the daily register and approve leave requests too.
Now each subject gets its teacher and periods per week. Meera takes English, Hindi and Maths, and Rohan takes Science, Social Studies and Computer Science.
Here comes the magic! BrightCampus builds the timetable all by itself. We pick Grade 3 A, and hit generate.
Look at that! Every subject got its periods, and no teacher is ever in two places at once. We publish it, so teachers, parents and students can all see it.
Older students get their own app too! One click creates passwords for the whole class. They sign in with the school code, admission number and password.
Before day one, Kavitha sends a warm welcome notice to all parents. It lands in the parent app instantly!
And it's the first day of school! Meera opens the BrightCampus teacher app, shown here in a desktop browser, and signs in.
She sets her own password, and she's right back in the teacher app. Smooth!
Her Today screen has everything: the Grade 3 A register to mark, today's classes from the timetable, and quick actions.
Attendance time! Aarav and Kabir are present, but Diya is absent. The moment Meera saves, Diya's father gets an alert. No phone calls needed!
Homework for English: write a short paragraph about my family, marked out of ten, due tomorrow. Parents are informed right away.
Now let's meet Vikram, Diya's father, on the BrightCampus parent app. He signs in with the details from the school office.
First, he picks his own password. Safety first!

Right on his home screen: Diya is absent today, and there's new English homework. And this colourful quick-access grid, just like a payments app, takes him to attendance, fees, timetable and results in a single tap!
His notifications show it all: the absence alert, the new homework, and the school's welcome notice.
Fees are crystal clear: the admission fee of eight thousand rupees, due on the tenth of October.
Now it's Aarav's turn! He signs in to the student app with the school code, his admission number and his password.
He sets his own password, and here's his day: today's lessons with his teachers, and the homework that's due.
He opens the homework, writes a little note, attaches a photo of his notebook, and hands it in, right from the app!
Back to Meera. She opens the homework and sees exactly who has handed it in.
She views Aarav's notebook photo, gives him nine out of ten with a lovely remark, and approves it. Aarav and his mom can see it immediately!
Over in the office, Farah from accounts signs in for the first time and sets her password.
Aarav's mom pays the admission fee at the counter using UPI. Farah finds Aarav, picks the fee, adds the UPI reference, and records it. Receipt created instantly!
Now, Neha, Aarav's mom, signs in to the parent app.
And there it is! The counter payment is already in her receipts: eight thousand rupees by UPI, with the receipt number and reference.
Under homework, Aarav's paragraph shows as reviewed, nine out of ten, with the teacher's remark. So proud!
And finally, our principal signs in and sets his password.
His dashboard shows the whole school at a glance: today's attendance, fees collected, and anything waiting for his approval. All live, all from today!

And that's the complete journey! A new school onboarded, set up, and running its very first day, with teachers, parents, students and the office all connected. That's BrightCampus. Thank you so much for watching!
